prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos for Best Results", "Provide 1 to 3 clear, well-lit photos of your pet facing forward.", "Choose Pet Photo", "Tip: Good lighting and a front-facing angle produce the most accurate pet design."]
1: ["Your Pet Is Arriving On Your Desktop", "Your pet will appear in the bottom right corner of your screen. Look for the desktop pet tray icon to bring them back anytime.", "See My Pet", "Note: You can drag your pet around or minimize them to the system tray."]
2: ["Welcome Your Companion Home!", "Your companion is active on your desktop screen. Here are quick ways to interact.", "Right-click pet for main menu | Drag to move | Double-click to talk"]
3: ["Sign In & Sync Your Pet", "Signing in ensures your desktop pet data and history are linked safely to your account.", "Existing Pets Auto-Restored On Sign In"]
4: ["Crafting Your Desktop Companion...", "We are preparing your pet's animations and desktop interactions. This may take a few minutes.", "Did you know? Desktop pets react when you drag windows near them!"]
5: ["Meet Your New Screen Companion", "Adopt a ready-made desktop pet or create a custom companion from your photos that lives on your screen while you work.", "Start Adoption Journey"]
6: ["Choose Your Pet's Personality", "How would you like your companion to behave on your screen?", "Save Personality", "Select Personality"]
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Name your new companion to complete the official adoption papers.", "Official Desktop Companion"]
8: ["Your Pet Is Being Prepared", "You can minimize this window. We'll send a system alert when your pet is ready on your desktop.", "Notify Me When Ready"]
9: ["How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?", "Pick a quick preset companion or build a unique pet from your own photos.", "Select Companion Type"]
